Coast to coast

The Camino de Costa Rica

From the Caribbean to the Pacific through forests, mountains and rural communities. Walk it all or in stages — logistics, lodging and guide included.

CaribbeanPacific
  1. 01
    Caribbean section · Stages 1–5
    From the Caribbean coast, rivers and farms up to the foothills.
  2. 02
    Central section · Stages 6–11
    Mountains, coffee farms and cloud forest through the heart of the country.
  3. 03
    Pacific section · Stages 12–16
    The final descent through valleys all the way to the Pacific Ocean.

Who we are

Local guides who love their land

We believe the best way to know Costa Rica is on foot, by bike or on the river, sharing time with the people who live there. Every trip is designed for small groups, with safety first and a pace you can enjoy.
